statement: The invoice record shows a contradiction: payment history indicates it was paid in full on 3 September (reference PAY-2291), but the status shows unpaid. To avoid a duplicate payment of USD 148,300, I will hold this invoice.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts "The invoice record shows a contradiction... paid in full... but the status shows unpaid," and refuses to pay to avoid a "duplicate payment of USD 148,300."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
